items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: was I worked with him in Providence, Rhode Island, at the Celebrity Club

ctx.x: Oh, let me see. Actually, I first

actually saw him in Detroit, when I was there with Dizzy, in person. He was just getting this band together with this sextet, with Teagarden and Earl Hines and Syd Catlett and Arvil Shaw. That's when I first heard him in person. But they were just gettin' together and I didn't really...it didn't really strike me, you know. Oh, in 1946 he was workin' at a place, he had a big band, but I was workin' down town and I went up there one night, but I was only in there for a few moments, so I didn't really get to it. But…

discipline. He was on the bandstand first and he kept his instru- ments clean and then in the afternoon I'd go by the hotel and he was very humerous. He took care of his teeth, he took care of himself. He had one case was for his trumpet and the other case was for his medicines. You know, he had a remedy for everything. So I says, "Well;", then that stuck with me. And then, naturally, after I got indoctrinated, then every time he would play in there, if I got a chance I would go to hear him. And it was the same…
